styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-health ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clinical deep blue #1C4E8C, soft cream #EFE7DA and warm oak #C89B6B with a single warm orange accent #E0854C and cream-filled gold-ring circular badges #D8A870; neutral-cool clean tone; modern geometric sans-serif Chinese typography with bold blue or white headlines and thin sublabels; consistent thin-line icon style inside gold-ring badges; flat infographic panels over soft blue gradients; neutral studio key with soft contact shadows and warm window light for lifestyle scenes; stable product scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 12 片详情页切片提炼；单一主体=猫咪体内外驱虫液体滴剂（盒装+管剂）。L1 与源夹「宠物用品」一致。品类清单在宠物用品下无驱虫/医药专用 L2，取语义最接近的「清洁」（除虫/卫生），并以此与既有拾便器(清洁工具)、沐浴露(美容)等区隔：本模版为猫咪驱虫药剂型、蓝色渐变+暖橡木台+金环圆形信息图视觉体系，与库内十版在宠物种类/品类/剂型/视觉体系上均不同。已剥离：滴剂管身品牌文字与剂量印刷、二维码、形似联系方式的货号数字、'加入会员/全店免费'店铺促销文案；猫咪模特仅保留物种形态、不指认个体；源图驱虫功效/病症字样与图表一律改为 {callout_*}/{selling_point_*} 占位符，未编造任何功效、认证或检测数据。
